title: Bucs OC Zac Robinson: Baker Mayfield "just not quite ready" to return this week

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bucs OC Zac Robinson: Baker Mayfield "just not quite ready" to return this week
sources.description: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield's absence from practice on Wednesday and Thursday were a sign that he won't be playing against the Steelers in Week 6 and offensive coordinator Zac Robinson confirmed it at his press conference on Thursday.
